tasks.spec: Create a four-second cinematic landscape shot with a locked camera, coherent natural motion, realistic lighting, and no text, lettering, logos, watermarks, people, private data, or brand marks. This specification is sent directly to the OpenRouter Video API by the Seedance engine; it is not a text-agent task.
